name: race_decided_takes_no_orders
description: A race decided while my hollow is still in a build window takes no more orders (review of M6's race views: the controller refused orders only once my hollow was won or lost, so between the decision and MATCH_END a tower could be placed and the horn called under the end plate). A Tide Race of two seats: the rival's hollow clears wave 12 two ticks in, before mine has seen a wave, so the race is decided against my team at once while my hollow stays in its first window. The end plate says so; Game.over() is true and every order is refused before it goes out with 'The match is over': no build (no ghost, no gold held), no Ready, no signal; the card greys and the party strip hides its Ready marks.

steps.msg: before the decision, my window takes orders

steps.assert: Game.outcome() == 'lost' and Game.sim.decided_by() == 'time' and Game.state == 0 and Game.wave == 0
steps.msg: the rival cleared first: decided against my team, my hollow still in its first window

steps.assert: Game.order_refusal() == 'The match is over' and not node('BuildController').can_build(Game.kit_tower(0), Vector2i(6, 11))

steps.msg: a build is refused: no ghost, no gold held
the card greys: Q, Signal and Ready
and the party strip shows no Ready marks
the match is over for me
